title: Nine Days and the Fourth
subtitle: 行动与实践 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 行动与实践（做人与做事·行动与实践）
meta: 主题语境：行动与实践（做人与做事·行动与实践）　|　核心词汇：action　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 action 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the pump stopped and the village waited nine days for somebody to ① take action, and my grandmother did not wait, and by the fourth day she had a spanner and two of the men from the lane. Action, she said, is what you do in the first hour, and after that it is called something else; the action of a spanner, she said, is the only honest thing in a village.

The ② action took four hours and two of the men never came back, and she said the ③ action, meaning what they actually did, was less than the waiting and more than the thanks. She wrote it in a book she kept for thirty-one years, an ④ action a day in four lines, and said the book was the only thing she had ever finished.

By 1981 she could not close her hand, and she said the ⑤ action of her own fingers had gone and that this was the first thing she had not been able to mend. The pump went ⑥ out of action again in 1984 and she stood and watched four men do it in an hour, and she said the pump had been ⑦ in action longer than any of them and that this was the whole of her argument.

Her brother was ⑧ killed in action in 1944, and she was nine, and she said the phrase had been the only thing in the letter that meant anything. She never used the word action about the war again, not once in fifty-one years, though she used it about pumps, fingers, men in a lane and ⑨ the action of a story she read four times; the action, she said, is what the war took out of the word.

The ⑩ action I would put in the book is the nine days, the fourth day and the two men who did not come back. Action, she told me in 1991, is only ever the part of a thing that shows, and the action is the only part that anybody will believe; the rest is a woman with a spanner deciding, and nobody has ever put that part in a book.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 行动；行动过程
B. n. 行为；所做之事
C. n. 作用；功能；运转（the action of the heart / a drug）
D. n. 战斗；作战（killed in action）
E. n. 情节；动作（the action of a story）
F. 固定搭配：take action (on sth.) 采取行动
G. 固定搭配：in action 在运转中；在活动中
H. 固定搭配：out of action 出故障；失去作用

items.q: the action, meaning what they actually did
an action a day in four lines
the action of her own fingers
went out of action again in 1984
had been in action longer than
the action of a story she read
The action I would put in the book

answers.why: take action 意为“采取行动”，1978 年水泵停了，全村等了九天才有人采取行动。
action 意为“行动、行动过程”，修泵那次行动花了四个小时。
action 意为“行为、所做之事”，她说他们实际所做的事比等待少、比感谢多。
action 意为“（一件）行为”，她在那本记了三十一年的簿子里每天用四行记一件行为。
the action of ... 意为“……的作用／功能”，她说自己手指的活动功能已经丧失。
out of action 意为“出故障、失去作用”，1984 年水泵又一次坏了。
in action 意为“在运转中”，她说这台泵运转的时间比他们任何人都长。
in action 指“战斗中”，哥哥 1944 年阵亡，那时她九岁。
the action of a story 意为“故事情节”，她把这个词用在小说情节上，却再也不用在战争上。
action 意为“行动”，我要写进书里的行动是那九天、第四天和没回来的两个人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年水泵停了，全村等了九天，等着有人采取行动。（take action）
那次行动花了四个小时，其中两个人再也没有回来。（action）
到 1981 年她握不拢手，说自己手指已经失去了活动功能。（the action of）
1984 年水泵又一次出了故障，她站着看四个男人一小时就修好了。（out of action）
她哥哥 1944 年阵亡，那时她九岁。（killed in action）
她说，行动永远只是一件事露在外面的那一部分。（action）
answers: In 1978 the pump stopped and the village waited nine days for somebody to take action.
The action took four hours, and two of the men never came back.
By 1981 she could not close her hand and said the action of her own fingers had gone.
The pump went out of action again in 1984, and she watched four men mend it in an hour.
Her brother was killed in action in 1944, when she was nine.
Action, she said, is only ever the part of a thing that shows.
